title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
keyIdea: Serialize in preorder and write # for every NULL child; the markers record the shape. Deserialize by splitting into a queue and reading tokens back in the same preorder: a number makes a node, then its left, then its right; # is NULL.

approaches.name: Preorder DFS with # for NULL
approaches.idea: serialize: val + "," then left, right ("#," for NULL). deserialize: tokens into a queue; pop: "#" → NULL, else node, build left, build right.
approaches.why: Every node and every NULL child is written once and read once.

options: Preorder alone can't tell different shapes apart; the #s fix every value's position
To mark the end of the string

quiz.q: Why must deserialize read in preorder too?
options: It has to consume tokens in exactly the order serialize wrote them
